verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only AP international vendor payments (doc-42) where vendors receive funds in local currency, not employee expense reimbursements; the S&E reimbursement docs (doc-2) mention 'reimbursements' generically but never local-currency/international reimbursement for employees abroad. Missing for 10: any documentation of employee reimbursement disbursement in local currency, any mention of multi-currency support within Spend & Expense card/reimbursement workflows, and confirmation this avoids a separate international payments process.
